journeyId.title: Journey Id
journeyId.description: journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action; empty on the first call.

sessionId.title: Messaging Session Id
sessionId.description: Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: New amount as typed, e.g. 3 lakh. Empty to keep the current amount.

tenure.title: Tenure
tenure.description: New tenure as typed, e.g. 48 months or 4 years. Empty to keep the current tenure.
